title: 2030 Census Rule: Public Comment Explorer
description_html:
Public comments on the Census Bureau's proposed rule Decennial Census of the Population of Americans; Proposed Residence Criteria and Proposed Regulations for Demographic Questions (docket USBC-2026-0628). Compiled by Women's Funding Network for member funds and partners.

Privacy: individual commenters are not named. Names, signatures, addresses, ZIP codes, emails and phone numbers are removed automatically, and individuals' attachments are not included. Organizations and public officials are named. Every row links to the original. If you spot a name that slipped through, please tell us.

comments.description: One row per comment. Form-letter copies point to the form_letters table (their shared text is stored once there). Position and topic flags are assigned by keyword rules and are approximate.

form_letters.description: Identical or near-identical letters submitted 3+ times, with the number of copies.

organizations.description: Comments filed by organizations, funders, governments and public officials (reviewed by WFN).

about.description: When this database was built and how it was made.

all_comments.description: Every comment with its full text. Form-letter copies show the shared letter. Position and topic flags are assigned by keyword rules and are approximate.

search.title: Search all comments
search.description_html: Form letters are listed once, with the number of copies sent, followed by organizations and individual comments. Matching words are shown in [brackets]. Each row links to the original on Regulations.gov (for form letters, one example copy).
search.sql:
select type, comments, position, posted, state, organization, excerpt, url from (
  select 'Form letter' as type, f.copies as comments, f.position, f.first_posted || ' to ' || f.last_posted as posted,
         null as state, null as organization,
         snippet(form_letters_fts, 0, '[', ']', ' … ', 40) as excerpt,
         'https://www.regulations.gov/comment/' || (select min(comment_id) from comments c where c.form_letter_id = f.form_letter_id) as url,
         0 as grp, f.copies as sort1, '' as sort2
  from form_letters_fts join form_letters f on f.form_letter_id = form_letters_fts.rowid
  where form_letters_fts match :q
  union all
  select case when c.commenter_type = 'organization' then 'Organization'
              when c.edited_from_form_letter is not null then 'Edited form letter' else 'Own words' end,
         1, c.position, c.posted, c.state, c.organization,
         snippet(comments_fts, 0, '[', ']', ' … ', 40), c.url,
         case when c.commenter_type = 'organization' then 1 else 2 end, 0, c.posted
  from comments_fts join comments c on c.rowid = comments_fts.rowid
  where comments_fts match :q
) order by grp, sort1 desc, sort2 desc

search_counts.title: How many comments match
search_counts.sql:
select
  (select coalesce(sum(f.copies), 0) from form_letters f where f.form_letter_id in
     (select rowid from form_letters_fts where form_letters_fts match :q)) as form_letter_copies,
  (select count(*) from comments_fts where comments_fts match :q) as other_comments

women_and_girls.title: Comments that mention women and girls
women_and_girls.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where women_girls = 1 order by c.posted desc

black_maternal_health.title: Comments that mention Black maternal health
black_maternal_health.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where black_maternal_health = 1 order by c.posted desc

biological_sex.title: Comments that mention "biological sex" or sex at birth
biological_sex.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where biological_sex = 1 order by c.posted desc

trans_nonbinary_intersex.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where trans_nonbinary_intersex = 1 order by c.posted desc

privacy_data_sharing.title: Comments about privacy and data sharing with Homeland Security
privacy_data_sharing.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where privacy_dhs = 1 order by c.posted desc

funders.title: Comments from foundations and funder networks
funders.sql: select posted, organization, position, state, region, url from organizations where org_group = 'Foundations & funders' order by posted desc

organizations_by_region.title: Organizations by region
organizations_by_region.sql: select region, count(*) as organizations, sum(position = 'oppose') as oppose, sum(position = 'support') as support, sum(position like 'extension%') as asked_for_more_time from organizations group by region order by organizations desc

comments_by_state.title: Comments by state (where the state could be identified)
comments_by_state.sql: select state, region, count(*) as comments, sum(position = 'oppose') as oppose, sum(position = 'support') as support from comments where state is not null group by state order by comments desc

comments_per_day.title: Comments posted per day
comments_per_day.sql: select posted, count(*) as comments, sum(form_letter_id is not null) as form_letter_copies, sum(commenter_type = 'organization') as organizations from comments group by posted order by posted

individually_written.title: Individually written comments (not form letters)
individually_written.sql: select posted, commenter_type, organization, position, state, text, url from comments where form_letter_id is null order by posted desc

lgbtq_same_sex.title: Comments about LGBTQ+ people and same-sex couples
lgbtq_same_sex.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where lgbtq_same_sex = 1 order by c.posted desc

sex_gender_general.title: Comments about sex and gender data (general)
sex_gender_general.sql: select c.posted, c.commenter_type, c.organization, c.position, c.state, coalesce(c.text, f.sample_text) as text, c.url from comments c left join form_letters f using (form_letter_id) where sex_gender_general = 1 order by c.posted desc
